wakeword.title: Wakeword
wakeword.intro: Capsula listens and learns on the device. Your browser never records audio.
wakeword.waitingState: Waiting for the microphone state from Capsula.
wakeword.microphoneMuted: The microphone is muted. Unmute it in Settings before recording.

wakeword.someDeleteFailed: {failed} of {total} recordings could not be deleted.

wakeword.metricsHint: Measured once when this wakeword was trained, on recordings held back from fitting. The external speech check uses a separate licensed corpus and is not the final certificate.

wakeword.historyUnavailable: Detection history is unavailable while the connection is down.
wakeword.noRecordings: No recordings yet. A new wakeword setup records its own takes.
wakeword.recordingsHint: Recordings belong to the device, not to one wakeword: deleting a wakeword keeps them, and only recordings chosen in a new setup are used for training.
wakeword.deleteAllBody: Delete {count} recording from Capsula? | Delete {count} recordings from Capsula?
wakeword.deleteAllWarning: This cannot be undone. Wakewords stay installed; only their saved recordings are removed.

training.stageAugment: Making varied copies of the recordings
training.stageNegatives: Studying room noise and other speech
training.stepDescSetup: Pick a word that will be used to summon an assistant
training.stepDescRoom: Let Capsula hear the normal background of the room.
training.stepDescSpeech: Capsula needs to hear ordinary speech that is not your wakeword.
training.stepDescWord: Record the word six times, in the variations shown.
training.stepDescReview: If everything's good, we'll start the training.

training.hintRoom: Leave the room sounding normal: fan, traffic, fridge. Do not speak.
training.hintSpeech: Read the phrase in a normal voice. Do not say your wakeword in this recording.
training.hintWord: Wait for the final, longer tone, then say the complete word once, about half a second later.
training.stayQuiet: Stay quiet for the whole recording.
training.wordVariation2: Say “{word}” louder than usual, without shouting.
training.wordVariation4: Say “{word}” from about two metres away.
training.wordVariation5: Say “{word}” as if calling someone by name.
training.wordVariation6: Say “{word}” softly, with your head turned slightly to one side.
training.cueWait: Capsula is showing the recording cue. Wait for the final tone before speaking.
training.replacementSaved: Replacement saved; the previous recording is no longer selected.
training.replacementOldFailed: The replacement is selected, but the old recording could not be deleted: {error}
training.connectionClosedRecording: The connection to Capsula closed before the recording finished.
training.trainingStoppedCheck: Training stopped. If you stopped it near the final step, refresh and check the current wakeword.
training.trainingStoppedBefore: Training stopped before a new wakeword was confirmed.
training.cancellationRequested: Cancellation requested; waiting for Capsula to confirm.
training.cancelUnconfirmed: Capsula did not confirm whether training stopped or finished. Close this dialog and check the current wakeword.
training.cancelFailed: Training could not be stopped from this page: {error}. It may still be running or may have finished; check the current wakeword after reconnecting.
training.connectionClosedTraining: The connection to Capsula closed. Training may have stopped or finished; check the current wakeword after reconnecting.
training.closingConfirm: Capsula will confirm whether it stopped or finished.
training.placementHint: Place the device in its usual place. Before recording it will produce three short tones.
training.fricativeHint: For the wakeword it's recommended to use a word with a fricative sound towards its end, because it's easier for algorithm to detect in a sound stream. Examples you probably know: "Крыса", "Маруся", "Алиса", "Яндекс", "Салют", "Сири", "Алекса".
training.reRecordHint: If you don't like any of the takes or want to re-record a take — no big deal, you can just delete a take and record again. No pressure.
training.recordRoom: Three room recordings of eight seconds each: background only.
training.recordSpeech: Four everyday phrases of four seconds each: ordinary speech without your wakeword.
training.recordWord: Six short wakeword recordings of two seconds each, in different ways of speaking.
training.wordHint: Use a distinctive word you can say naturally. Keep saying the same word throughout setup.
training.languageHint: Pick the language you will speak during the recordings.
training.moreTakes: You can record more takes than required for better detection accuracy.
training.alreadyMade: This setup already made a wakeword. Start a new setup with fresh recordings before training again.
training.finalTestUsed: The final check has already been used for these recordings. Start a new setup with fresh recordings; the same recordings cannot be used to check another model.
training.waitingRecordings: Waiting for Capsula’s saved recordings before training can start.
training.enoughAudio: We've recorded enough audio to begin training the wakeword model. If you want to add more for better accuracy, you can go back and do it.
training.wakewordReady: Your wakeword is ready on Capsula
training.nothingSwitchedOn: Nothing was switched on automatically. Close this dialog, then use the Wakeword section to choose this wakeword and turn detection on.
training.missingWord: {count} more wakeword recording | {count} more wakeword recordings
training.missingRoom: {count} more room recording | {count} more room recordings
training.missingPhrase: {count} more phrase recording | {count} more phrase recordings
